newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to raise Sept wholesale product prices.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to raise Sept wholesale product prices.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Friday it would raise its wholesale prices for gasoline, gas oil and kerosene by 0.3 yen per litre for September shipments due to the yen's depreciation against the dollar.
This will be the first time in six months that the refiner has raised wholesale prices in its monthly price adjustment.
The price hike is a result of a decline in yen's value against the U.S. dollar, which outweighed lower crude oil prices for July-loading, a company spokesman said.

The upward adjustment will bring the price of gasoline to 88.3 yen per litre, gas oil to 66.6 yen, both including tax. Kerosene, which is not taxed at the wholesale level, will be 34.5 yen a litre, he said.
Most Japanese oil firms review their oil product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international crude prices as well as fluctuations in the currency market.
